definitions.full: H774. Arpad אַרְמַּד proper name, of a location city in northern Syria (Assyrian Arpadda Dl Pa 275 ) — ׳א Isa 10:9 elsewhere אַרְמָּ֑ד ; approximately 15 miles north of Aleppo, modern Tel Erfâd ; in OT only as conquered by Assyria, always named with Hamath, etc. 2Kin 18:34 ; 19:13 = Isa 36:19 ; 37:13 (on ᵐ5 Ῥαφέθ = Ἀρφάθ compare Lag BN 78 ), also 10:9 ; Jer 49:23 ; (compare Nö ZMG 1871, 258 Kiep ib. 655. )
